summary: Prudential plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing an on-market share buyback of 277,659 ordinary shares at a volume-weighted average price of 11.2657 GBP per share, with prices ranging from 11.2350 to 11.3050 GBP. The repurchases were executed through JP Morgan Securities plc under a shareholder-authorised arrangement initiated on 6 January 2026. Shares will be cancelled, reducing the issued count to 2,522,727,996. This routine return of capital follows prior authorisation and is conducted on the London Stock Exchange and under Hong Kong buy-back rules. Watch for continued buyback execution pace.
